findings.name: Glaive Tempest
findings.baseline: Recommended as a standalone cast in three Havoc APL rules, whitelisted with a 25-second fallback cooldown, and counted as a 30-Fury spender.
findings.source: Passive talent 1244557 triggers background Glaive Tempest from Blade Dance or Death Sweep when conditions hold; 342817 is absent from the class module create_action factory.

findings.name: Talent-dependent maximum Fury
findings.baseline: Havoc maximum Fury modeled as fixed 120.
findings.source: The pinned trace reports 170 maximum Fury for its selected build; Untethered Fury 452411 has a +50-Fury effect. This does not establish a universal 170 cap.
findings.status: fixed for public UnitPowerMax; conservative fallback remains approximate when unavailable
findings.certainty: 170 is trace fact; talent explanation is source-backed inference

findings.name: Generator Fury
findings.baseline: Demon's Bite and Felblade both generated 40 Fury.
findings.source: Demon's Bite effect generates 25 Fury; Felblade triggered damage 213243 generates 15 Fury. The trace log separately records 15 Fury from Felblade.

findings.name: Cooldown fallback and shared variant identity
findings.baseline: Eye Beam 40 seconds and Metamorphosis 240 seconds in the whitelist; Blade Dance fixed 9 seconds and Felblade 15 seconds remain approximate.
findings.source: Base Eye Beam is 30 seconds, Metamorphosis 120, Blade Dance 15 before haste/form sharing, and Felblade 12. The trace reports cooldown spell 452497 for Eye Beam's Abyssal Gaze variant.
findings.status: partially fixed: Eye Beam30, Metamorphosis120, shared Felblade12 base fallback; live variant/shared hasted cooldown unresolved
findings.certainty: base cooldowns source fact; addon API identity unresolved

findings.name: Conditional Fury and burst windows
findings.baseline: Immolation Aura modeled as immediate +20 Fury only; APL Essence Break opener metadata says 10 seconds while base cooldown is 40.
findings.source: Immediate Havoc Fury effect is +20; Burning Hatred talent can add +3 per tick. Essence Break base cooldown is 40 seconds. Proc uptime and hasted cooldown timing require observable state.
findings.status: Essence Break metadata corrected40; immediate20 already correct; conditional ticks remain open

Eye Beam to Abyssal Gaze cooldown identity may need runtime override handling; do not add an override pair based only on a SimC trace.
